ja: 私ならその返信は和らげる。
en: If I were you, I'd soften it.
alternatives: I'd soften that reply.
In your shoes, I'd soften that reply.
point: soften は表現のきつさを和らげる。

ja: 先週共有した資料を更新しました。
en: I updated the file shared last week.
alternatives: I updated the document we shared last week.
I updated the file that was shared last week.
point: 過去分詞で名詞を後ろから修飾

ja: 私には法務からまだ返信がない。
en: I haven't heard a peep from legal.
alternatives: I've had no reply from legal yet.
Legal still hasn't gotten back to me.
point: not hear a peep は一言も音沙汰がないこと。

ja: 助言を一つください。
en: Please give me a suggestion.
alternatives: Please offer me one suggestion.
I'd like a suggestion, please.
point: suggestion は一つ二つと数えられる。

ja: 私が返信していい？
en: May I reply?
alternatives: Can I respond?
Is replying okay?
point: May I で返信する許可を確認する。

ja: 再送していただけないでしょうか？
en: I wonder if you could resend it.
alternatives: I was wondering if you could resend it.
Would you mind resending it?
point: I was wondering if で依頼を和らげる

ja: 明日の朝、返信します。
en: I'll reply tomorrow morning.
alternatives: I'm going to reply tomorrow morning.
I'll write back tomorrow morning.
point: その場で決めた予定は I'll。「明日の朝」は tomorrow morning

ja: 上司をCCに入れるべきだった。
en: I should have cc'd my boss.
alternatives: I should have copied my boss in.
I should have looped my boss in.
point: 後悔や反省は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 私はメッセージを転送した。
en: I forwarded the message.
alternatives: I sent the message on.
I passed along the message.
point: forward は届いたメールなどを転送する。

ja: 昨日返信していれば、今慌てていない。
en: If I'd replied yesterday, I wouldn't be scrambling.
alternatives: Had I replied yesterday, I wouldn't be scrambling now.
If I had replied yesterday, I wouldn't be panicking now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は would be

ja: 私に必要なのは、事前の一言です。
en: What I need is a heads-up first.
alternatives: What I'd like is a heads-up beforehand.
All I need is a heads-up first.
I just need a heads-up first.
point: What〜is の強調。「事前の一言」は a heads-up

ja: 添付を忘れてすみません。
en: Sorry, I forgot the attachment.
alternatives: Sorry, I forgot to attach the file.
Sorry, I left out the attachment.
point: 特定の添付は the attachment

ja: 明日、彼にもう一度連絡します。
en: I'll follow up with him tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll circle back with him tomorrow.
I'll check in with him again tomorrow.
point: 「改めて連絡する」は follow up with

ja: これ、法務にも見てもらってください。
en: Please get legal to look at this too.
alternatives: Please get legal to review this too.
Please have legal look at this too.
Please get legal to look this over too.
point: get + 人 + to 原形、have + 人 + 原形

ja: 私にも CC してください。
en: Please CC me too.
alternatives: Please copy me too.
Add me to the CC too.
point: 命令文に Please。「私に」は me

ja: ここに誤字があります。
en: There's a typo here.
alternatives: There's a typo in here.
I see a typo here.
point: 「ある」は There's + 単数。typo の前は a

ja: 私は添付を開ける。
en: I can open attachments.
alternatives: I'm able to open attachments.
I can open attached files.
point: can open で添付ファイルを開ける能力や状況。

ja: 助けたいのは山々ですが、手一杯です。
en: Much as I'd like to help, I'm swamped.
alternatives: Much as I want to help, I'm snowed under.
I'd love to help, but I'm swamped.
point: Much as ~ は「〜したいのは山々だが」

ja: 今メール書いてます。
en: I'm writing an email.
alternatives: I'm writing an email now.
I'm typing an email.
point: 「今〜している」は am + -ing。email の前は an

ja: 私のメールは雑務に埋もれた。
en: My email was lost in the shuffle.
alternatives: My email got overlooked amid the busywork.
My email got buried under busywork.
point: lost in the shuffle は忙しさの中で見落とされること。

ja: 君は誰にメッセージ送った？
en: Who did you message?
alternatives: Who did you send it to?
Who received your message?
point: who did you で送信先を尋ねる。

ja: Slack が朝から鳴ってる。
en: My Slack's been pinging all morning.
alternatives: Slack has been buzzing since this morning.
My Slack has been going off all morning.
point: 朝からずっと続く動作は現在完了進行形

ja: 私はもう関係者を話に加えた。
en: I've already looped in the stakeholders.
alternatives: I've already included the stakeholders.
I've already brought the stakeholders in.
point: loop in は関係者を話に加える。

ja: 私が求めるのは率直な感想。
en: What I want is frank feedback.
alternatives: I want frank feedback.
I'm asking for candid feedback.
point: frank は率直な、feedback は数えない。

ja: 読み終えて、すぐ返信した。
en: Having read it, I replied immediately.
alternatives: After reading it, I replied right away.
I read it and replied right away.
point: 先に終えた動作は having + 過去分詞

ja: 私はもう宛先を確認した。
en: I've already checked the recipients.
alternatives: I've already verified who'll receive it.
I've already confirmed the recipients.
point: already と現在完了で確認済みを伝える。

ja: 宛先は先に確認したほうがいい。
en: You should double-check the recipients first.
alternatives: You'd better double-check the recipients first.
It's worth double-checking the recipients first.
point: 助言は should、再確認は double-check

ja: 今日中に、ケンに送らせます。
en: I'll have Ken send it today.
alternatives: I'll get Ken to send it today.
I'll have Ken send it later today.
point: have + 人 + 原形。get は to が必要

ja: 送った提案書、何か返事はある？
en: Any word on the proposal I sent?
alternatives: Any update on the proposal I sent?
Heard anything on the proposal I sent?
point: 「何か返事は？」は Any word on ～? が定番

ja: 早めに返信ください。
en: Please reply soon.
alternatives: Please reply quickly.
Reply soon, please.
point: お願いの命令文は Please を付けて動詞から始める

ja: それ、送ってくれる？
en: Can you send it?
alternatives: Could you send it?
Would you send it?
point: お願いは Can you / Could you。丁寧なのは Could

ja: 知っていたら、早く返信したのに。
en: If I'd known, I'd have replied sooner.
alternatives: Had I known, I would have replied sooner.
If I had known, I would have replied earlier.
point: if + 過去完了、would have + 過去分詞

ja: もっと早く返信しなくてごめん。
en: Sorry for not replying sooner.
alternatives: I'm sorry I didn't reply earlier.
Sorry for not getting back to you sooner.
point: 謝る理由は for + -ing、否定は not を前に

ja: 君が何を添付したか教えて。
en: Tell me what you attached.
alternatives: Let me know which files you attached.
Tell me what you've attached.
point: what 節を添付したものの意味で使う。

ja: あの返信、寝かせとけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd sat on that reply.
alternatives: I wish I'd waited before sending that reply.
I wish I'd held off on sending that reply.
I should have sat on that reply.
point: 「寝かせる」は sit on。過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: メールより電話が早いよ。
en: A call is faster than email.
alternatives: Calling is quicker than emailing.
It's faster to call than to email.
point: 比べる相手は than のあとに置く

ja: これは急ぎです。
en: This is urgent.
alternatives: It's urgent.
This can't wait.
point: 「急ぎ」は urgent。be 動詞は is

ja: これ、誰に送ればいい？
en: Who should I send this to?
alternatives: Who do I send this to?
Who should this go to?
point: 前置詞 to は文末に残る

ja: この文面は前より丁寧。
en: This wording is more polite now.
alternatives: This message sounds more polite now.
This wording is politer than before.
point: more polite now は文面が以前より丁寧になったことを表す。

ja: 届いたらすぐ返信します。
en: I'll reply once I get it.
alternatives: I'll reply when I get it.
I'll reply as soon as it arrives.
point: when 節は未来のことでも現在形

ja: 彼は明日送ると言った。
en: He said he'd send it tomorrow.
alternatives: He told me he'd send it tomorrow.
He said he was sending it tomorrow.
point: said のあとは will が would に変わる

ja: 添付が二つあります。
en: There are two attachments.
alternatives: Two files are attached.
There are two files attached.
point: 複数なら There are。名詞は attachments

ja: 私は君に署名してほしい。
en: I want you to sign.
alternatives: I'd like you to sign.
I want your signature.
point: want + 人 + to で署名してほしいと伝える。

ja: 日程確認でご連絡しました。
en: Writing to confirm the date.
alternatives: I'm writing to confirm the date.
I'm emailing to confirm the date.
point: 目的は to + 動詞の原形で言える

ja: 彼に返信するよう頼んだ。
en: I asked him to reply.
alternatives: I asked him to write back.
I asked him to respond.
point: ask + 人 + to do。人は him と目的格

ja: 彼が指摘した件、解決したと思う。
en: I think what he flagged is resolved.
alternatives: I think the issue he flagged has been resolved.
I think the problem he raised is resolved.
point: I think の後ろに what 節が入れ子になる

ja: 私は既にその件を決着させていた。
en: I'd already closed that loop.
alternatives: I'd already settled that matter.
I'd already tied up that loose end.
point: close the loop は未決のやり取りを完結させること。

ja: 忙しいとは思うけど、確認お願い。
en: I know you're busy, but please check.
alternatives: I know you're busy, but could you check this?
Although you're busy, could you check this?
point: Although の節に but は重ねない
